answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Islamic Beliefs Question ID: 3219 Country: Pakistan Title: Why all of 124,000 messengers sent by God were men. Why not a single woman never assigned a duty to forward the envelop of God? Question: Why all of 124,000 messengers sent by God were men. Why not a single woman never assigned a duty to forward the envelop of God? Answer ID: 3219 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 414/299=H) This is the requirement of this high post of prophet-hood and her modesty and chastity is more protected without it. There are many other reasons which are hidden from common people, and Allah knows the ghaib . Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
